newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Tristate says in privatisation talk.
newsitem.headline: Tristate says in privatisation talk.

text.p: Garment, trading and property firm Tristate Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it was in discussions with its controlling shareholders to privatise the company.

"The company is currently in discussions with its controlling shareholders regarding a possible privatisation of the company," the company's chairman Timothy McGinnis said in a statement issued throught the stock exchange on Tuesday.
However, the company said no final decision has been made by the controlling shareholders and the company in relation to such a privatisation.
Tristate said further details will be announced when appropriate. It also advises shareholders and investors to exercise caution in dealings in the company securities.
Tristate shares rose HK$0.425 or 10 percent to HK$4.675 per share in early trade on Tuesday.
